attempts.raw_response: When troubles come upon you, do not despair, but turn your heart toward Him with confidence and patience. Every difficulty you encounter is an opportunity to practice the virtues He desires to see in you: kindness, humility, and perseverance. The path is not always easy, and there will be moments when you feel weak or discouraged. Yet even then, you are not alone. Your prayers are heard, and your efforts are seen. Do not compare yourself to others, but strive each day to be a little better than you were yesterday. Small steps taken faithfully will lead you far. Surround yourself with good companions who encourage your growth, and avoid those who would lead you astray. Above all, trust that the journey itself has meaning, and that each act of love brings you nearer to the home He has prepared.

pair.human_continuation:
You will
be a better boy if you conquer your weakness, and become cheerful and
contented, than you could have been, had no sacrifice been required of
you. My dear child, I do believe God will bless you, and enable you to
conquer."

With such words Mrs. Hamilton sought to soothe and strengthen her child,
while her own heart was throbbing with painful emotions. She could not
sleep that night, for her heart yearned over her darling boy, and she
longed to fold him under the shelter of a loving home. She felt that she
needed in her own heart more of that perfect submission to God's will
which she enjoined on others, and it was only by earnest and humble
prayer that she could calm her troubled spirit, and feel trust and
confidence that all was for the best.
pair.prefix:
Think of
your Father in heaven, who watches over you, and will be well-pleased
when you try to subdue your faults. Never forget to ask Him for strength
to do right, and He will give it, if you ask in sincerity. Remember
always that He has placed us in the world to become his children, and
grow holy; and it is often through trial, we are made better.

source_document.title: Arthur Hamilton and His Dog by Anonymous
